How it plays. Each prompt is rebuilt as an interactive task: order the steps, assemble a line, repair a blank, classify ideas, or type the answer from memory. No four-button multiple choice.

Prompts shuffle deterministically from the local bank; the shared runtime adapts each one to the current mechanic.

Controls

  • Clickselect, place, or sort a piece
  • Entercheck the answer
  • Hshow a hint
  • Escpause / resume
  • Rrestart the run
